systems.tiers: called operational, providing data for planning school enrolment, teacher deployment and resource distribution; who enters what, and how often, is not described; named for Phase 1 interoperability pilots with DHIS2 and IFMIS, and for integration with DHIS2 and CRVS

note: A national data framework that names the EMIS as an operational source of planning data and as a party to planned interoperability pilots (budgeted for 2027), without saying what schools enter in it; unclassified, so no fact.
